summary: Payment API and Refund API recovered at 14:20 UTC.
body:
Payment API reported elevated errors at 14:00 UTC.
The team reverted a deployment at 14:12 UTC.
Payment API returned to its normal success rate at 14:20 UTC.
Refund API still has delayed requests at 14:20 UTC.
The cause remains unconfirmed.
